open_points.subject: prepare_request request_digest
open_points.text: - prepare_request: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] The description lists the method, the full URL with its query, and every header sent on the wire with names lower-cased in code point order, each with its value except the credential header and content-length, which appear with value None, and a multipart content type without its boundary parameter; its body is the JSON body as text, or for multipart the parts in order each with name, filename when present, media type and the SHA-256 of the part content, so the boundary never enters it.
open_points.other_text: - prepare_request: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] request_digest is content_identity of the canonical JSON of the description, so equal requests give equal digests, a rotated credential value changes nothing and any other difference changes the digest; the credential value never appears in the description, the digest or any reason.
open_points.question: Must multipart-boundary differences also change request_digest as required by “any other difference,” or is the boundary an additional difference that must be excluded from that claim?
